groups.title: Whirlpool Washing Machine Mechanical & Drain Issues

items.q: Why is my Whirlpool washing machine not draining water and showing an error code in Ellis Nagar?
items.a: Water drainage failure in front load and top load washers is usually caused by small objects (coins, safety pins, lint clumps) jamming the drain pump impeller, a kinked drain hose, or a burned-out drain motor coil. In Ellis Nagar, our technician opens the lower service flap, clears debris, and tests the pump discharge rate.

items.q: Why does my Whirlpool washing machine vibrate violently and make loud grinding noises during spin cycle?
items.a: Excessive vibration and grinding during spin typically point to worn tub bearings, a fractured spider arm, or fatigued suspension damper rods. Hard borewell water in certain Madurai localities can accelerate mineral scale corrosion around bearing water seals. Replacing bearings and dampers restores smooth, balanced spinning.

items.q: Water fill aagite irukku aana wash cycle start aagala? Enna seivardhu?
items.a: If water fills continuously without stopping, the air pressure sensor tube may be clogged with detergent scum, or the electronic water level sensor has failed. If water trickles very slowly, calcified sediment in the inlet solenoid filter is usually the cause. Our technician cleans filters and calibrates the sensor directly at your home.

groups.title: Spare Parts & Washing Machine Repair Charges in Madurai

items.q: What is the cost of Whirlpool washing machine drain pump or inlet valve replacement in Madurai?
items.a: Replacing an inlet solenoid valve or magnetic drain pump generally ranges from ₹850 to ₹1,850 depending on whether it is a semi-automatic, top load, or front load unit. Final cost depends on model, fault and parts required, and our technician confirms the price before beginning work.

items.q: How much does washing machine drum bearing replacement cost?
items.a: Tub bearing overhaul requires drum dismantling, fitting high-grade double bearings, and a new synthetic rubber oil seal, typically ranging from ₹1,800 to ₹3,500. Technician inspection is required before confirming the final repair cost, as tub condition and spider arm integrity must be evaluated.
